title: 💬 Send feedback
items: Found a bug or have an idea? Tap 💬 Send feedback in the main menu (or 💬 Feedback in the pause menu) and tell us.
It can include what you were doing (screen, track, device) so bugs are easier to fix. Every message gets read!

title: 🔑 Your player on every device
items: Settings now has a Your player section: change your name there, and find your player code.

Playing on another phone or computer? Tap "Send to myself" (or "Copy my link") and open the link there, or tap "I have a code" and type it in. That device becomes you: same name, racer and Custom look, and your times on the boards.
If you'd already raced on that device, nothing is lost: its times and stats are added to yours, and each board keeps your better time, so you won't show up twice.
Change your name on one device and the others pick it up. Keep your code to yourself. If someone else gets it, tap "New code" and the old one stops working.

title: Records to beat in Time Trial
items: Picking a Time Trial track now shows its track record (fastest full race) and its lap record, with who set them, plus your own best.
During a Time Trial, the lap record and track record sit under your timer so you know what you're chasing.
Before, the track picker only showed times saved in that browser, so on a new phone or computer every track said "No record yet".

title: Chamo Kart, now in English
items: The items now go by their Mario Kart names: Green Shell, Red Shell, Mushroom, Triple Mushrooms, Star, Lightning and Blooper. The Mushroom and Blooper have new icons, and the Blooper squirts black ink.
Everything else is in English too: the Classic, Bullet and Buggy karts, the Snowy Peak and Sunshine Beach tracks, the Chamo Cup, and Chicky and Skully on the racer list.
Wins, share cards, invites and the tutorial speak English now, and so does the CX-9's "Mashamiiiiii!".

title: Every Mario Kart item
items: 14 new items join the item boxes: Triple Bananas, Triple Green Shells, Triple Red Shells, Blue Shell, Golden Mushroom, Bullet Bill, Bob-omb, Fire Flower, Boomerang Flower, Piranha Plant, Super Horn, Boo, Coin and Crazy Eight.
The Blue Shell flies up the track and blows up whoever's in first. Save a Super Horn to knock it out of the sky!
Bullet Bill drives for you and rockets up the track, the Boo turns you invisible and steals an item, and the Piranha Plant chomps anything in front of you.
The better items still go to the racers at the back. See them all in 🎮 How to Play.

title: 🎓 Learn to race
items: New interactive tutorial: a coach rides along on Chamo Circuit and teaches you, one step at a time, to steer, grab coins, drift, fire mini-turbos, use item boxes, hold a banana behind you, throw cocos, hit speed boosters and land ramp tricks.
It cheers when you get it right, tells you how far the next coin, box, booster or ramp is (and marks it on the minimap), and you can skip any step.
Find it in 🎮 How to Play. New players get offered it before their first race.

title: ¡Meowww!
items: Whenever Dorito rolls over a speed booster, he looks back over his shoulder and lets out a big "¡Meowww!" (you'll hear it from a nearby Dorito too).
Works in online races, in the replays and when you watch someone race.

title: Meet Dorito 🐱
items: Dorito, a real orange tabby, takes Luchador's spot: stripes, big pink ears, sleepy green-gold eyes, long whiskers and a tail that swishes faster the faster he goes.
He drives a Doritos-orange kart with a tortilla chip on the nose, and keeps Luchador's stats: top speed and weight.

title: Build your own racer
items: Calavera made room for ✏️ Custom: your own racer, built from scratch. Pick Custom on the racer screen (or tap ✏️ Edit my racer).

Avatar: 8 heads (human, calavera, robot, alien, cat, bear, frog, pumpkin), eyes, mouth, hair, 14 hats, outfits with your own number, and extras like a cape, wings or a jetpack. Every part takes any colour.
Car: pick the body, paint and finish (gloss, matte, metallic, chrome, neon), trim, rims, decals (flames, stripes, your number…), a spoiler, a flag, underglow and the colour of your boost flames.
Stats: share 12 points between speed, acceleration, weight and handling, like every other racer.
Everyone sees exactly what you made: in online rooms, the Players list, when they watch you race, and on the Fastest laps boards and their ghosts. CPU racers still include Calavera.

title: Watch races live
items: Open 👥 Players and tap 👀 Watch next to anyone who's racing to watch their race live, with their laps, place, items and the minimap.
Works for every mode: Grand Prix, Versus, Time Trial, the Daily Challenge and online races. When their race ends, you'll see their next one automatically.
Tap 🔄 Next racer (or use ← →) to follow someone else in the race. ✕ Stop (or Esc) goes back.
When someone's watching you, you'll see 👀 at the top of the screen.

title: Show off, and bring your friends
items: New 📸 Share button after every race and on the Grand Prix podium: it makes a picture of your result (your racer, your place or time, the track and a shot of the race) to post in the group chat.
On your phone, 📲 Share sends the picture straight to WhatsApp, Instagram or anywhere else. You can also save it.
Online rooms have a green WhatsApp button that sends your friends the invite link in one tap.

title: Instant replay
items: After every Grand Prix, Versus and Online race, watch the best moments before the results: big hits, lead changes, huge jumps, falls and the finish, with TV cameras and slow motion.
Your own moments get priority. Nail someone with a coco and it'll probably make the cut!
Not in the mood? Tap Skip ▶▶ or press Esc, Enter or Space to go straight to the results.

title: See who's playing and challenge them
items: The 👥 button at the top of the menu shows who else is playing right now, and what they're up to.
Tap ⚔️ Challenge next to someone: you get a private room, and they get an invite to join you. If they're mid-race, it waits until they finish.

Turn on 🔔 Notifications on the Players screen to hear when a friend starts playing or challenges you, even with the game closed. On iPhone, add Chamo Kart to your Home Screen first (Share → Add to Home Screen).

title: Race the record ghost
items: Time Trial now lets you race the ghost of the #1 lap on the Fastest laps board: the whole run it was set in, with the record holder's name floating over it.
Pick the ghost under the tracks: Yours, #1, or Both at once. Or open 🏆 Fastest laps and tap 👻 Race #1's ghost.
Set a lap that makes the board and your run becomes a ghost everyone can race. Entries with a ghost show a 👻.

title: Hold it behind you
items: Hold the item button to drag a banana or Red Coco behind your kart as a shield, just like in Mario Kart. It blocks cocos from behind, and anyone who runs into it spins out.
Let go to drop the banana or fire the coco. A quick tap works just like before, and holding down still throws backwards.
Getting hit knocks it loose. The CPU racers have learned the trick too.

title: New track: Zoo City, and a Green Coco shield
items: Zoo City, the 8th track, winds through a zoo in the middle of the city. Wave at giraffes, elephants, lions, zebras, penguins, flamingos, pandas, monkeys and hippos in their enclosures along the track.
Pick it in Versus, Time Trial or Online. It has its own Fastest laps board and joins the Daily Challenge rotation from tomorrow.
Green Cocos now circle your kart as a shield when you pick one up. They block bananas and cocos and knock over anyone who touches them. Press the item button to fire it like before.
Careful: getting hit knocks the shield loose.

title: New track: Miami Vice
items: Race through a humid Miami night on Miami Vice, the 7th track. Pick it in Versus, Time Trial or Online.
Start on Ocean Drive, past art deco hotels glowing in pink and teal neon, then head out over the bay on two causeways. The second one's drawbridge is up, so hit the ramp and jump it.
Go-fast boats race across the water, downtown's skyline glows on the far shore, and a thunderstorm keeps flashing lightning out over the ocean.
Miami Vice has its own Fastest laps board and joins the Daily Challenge rotation from tomorrow.

title: Bumblebee: robot in disguise
items: El Toro has left the herd. Bumblebee takes his spot: a yellow muscle car with black racing stripes, whichever kart you pick (your kart still sets the stats).
Press D mid-race to transform into a robot, and D again to turn back into a car. Online, everyone sees it happen.
Driving Bumblebee, steer with the arrow keys: D is busy transforming.
He keeps El Toro's stats and his spot on the grid, so if you raced as El Toro, you're Bumblebee now.

title: Spider-Man joins the grid
items: Paco has hung up his sombrero. Spider-Man takes his spot, in a web-covered red and blue Spider-Mobile, whichever kart you pick (your kart still sets the stats).
Look for the spider-signal headlight, the web shooters on the nose and the spider on the rear wing.
He keeps Paco's stats and his spot on the grid, so if you raced as Paco, you're Spider-Man now.

title: New track: Mars Aliens
items: Race across the red planet on Mars Aliens, the 6th track. Pick it in Versus, Time Trial or Online.
Low gravity: jumps float, so hit the ramp and sail over the crater just after the start line.
Flying saucers cruise overhead with their tractor beams on, a mothership has landed in the big crater, and the locals come out to wave.
Mars Aliens has its own Fastest laps board, and it joins the Daily Challenge rotation from tomorrow.

title: Meet Lucas
items: Nena has left the grid. Say hi to Lucas, a T-rex who drives an orange pickup truck, whichever kart you pick (your kart still sets the stats).
His head pokes out of the sunroof, his tail hangs out the back window, and his tiny arms can't quite reach the wheel.
He keeps Nena's stats and her spot on the grid, so if you raced as Nena, you're Lucas now.

title: agenteintermediario rolls up in style
items: agenteintermediario now drives a black 2019 Mazda CX-9, whichever kart you pick (your kart still sets the stats).
Press D mid-race to swing all four doors open, and D again to close them. Every time, agenteintermediario shouts “¡Mashamiiiiii!” Online, everyone sees the doors and the bubble.
Driving the CX-9, steer with the arrow keys: D is busy with the doors.

title: Daily Challenge
items: New 📅 Daily Challenge: one track, one racer and one kart a day, the same for everyone.
Race it as often as you like. Your best 3-lap time goes on today's board, and your best run comes back as a ghost to chase.
A new challenge starts every day at midnight UTC. Check yesterday's podium to see who took the crown.

title: Fastest laps
items: New 🏆 Fastest laps boards: the top 10 laps on every track, from racers everywhere.
Set a lap in Time Trial and your best one is posted automatically. Can you make #1?
Pick the name shown next to your times on the Fastest laps screen.

title: What's new?
items: This screen! Whenever the game gets an update, you'll see what changed right here when you load the game.
Missed something? Open it any time with 📜 What's new in the main menu.

title: Talk while you race
items: Voice chat: join from the online lobby and talk with everyone in the room (V to mute).
In-race chat: press Enter or T, or tap 💬, to trash-talk mid-race.
One-tap rematch after an online race.
Tilt steering: Settings → Steering → Tilt phone and drive your phone like a wheel.

title: ¡Arranca, chamo! Chamo Kart is out
items: Grand Prix: race the 5-track Copa Chamo and win the trophy.
Versus races, Time Trial against your ghost, and online rooms for up to 8 racers.
8 racers, 3 karts and a splash of Chamoy.
